reason: A DSH Web UI extension suite centered on interface customization and workspace enhancements, with skins, panels, visualization, mobile access, task automation, SSH operations, and image-understanding integration documented in the README.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 提供可插拔的主题皮肤、任务看板、Git 图谱、侧边面板、移动端远程访问及 SSH 等界面与工作区扩展。
summaries.en: A pluggable DSH Web UI suite that adds skins, task boards, Git visualization, side panels, mobile remote access, SSH operations, and related workspace features.

capabilities: Extends the DSH Web UI with task boards, Git visualization, side panels, mobile remote access, skins, and companion UI features
Schedules and executes tasks through DSH agent sessions
Performs remote SSH terminal operations, file transfers, port forwarding, and multi-host command execution
Connects to configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoints for image description
Loads local skin assets and Wallpaper Engine media as interface backgrounds
